'''Ship Two''' was a [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian Fighter]].

==History==
This [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] fought in the [[Assault on Sarapin|First Battle of Sarapin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was one of several Geonosian Fighters used against the orbital [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] base.
